service_gap_audit.detail: No need/usage pair in the MOL 15-29 youth labour survey satisfies the requirement that both sides share a response model, a denominator and a construct. The need question is multi-response over broad policy wishes; the usage questions are single-response over specific named services. Computing need minus usage would produce a number that describes nobody.
missing_data_required: A survey item asking whether a wanted service was actually sought, and if so whether it was obtained (i.e. an explicit unmet-need item).
Need and usage measured over the same response model — either both single-response per service, or both multi-response with the same cap.
Need categories named at the same granularity as the delivered services (per named service, not per broad policy wish).
A common denominator statement, so the two shares are shares of the same base.
